title: Code of practice for design and construction of floors and roofs with prefabricated brick panel
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down recommendations for design and construction of floor and roof with prefabricated brick panels.
clause_3_terminology: Code of practice for design and construction of floors and roofs with prefabricated brick panel

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
